Event: Varworth summit. Host: Lorcan Vardale. Budget: 41,000. Venue: Morton Hall.
Staffing: Teo out; Mira covers. Una, Greta, Ada, Kira out. Pia, Opal, Finn, Bram, Dell, Esme, Ines, Wren, Leon, Suri, Cora, Rafe, Nils, Jonah, Hugo, Vik covering. Swap list: Jonah/Dell, Una/Finn, Ines/Vik, Opal/Hugo, Nils/Rafe, Cora/Suri, Esme/Teo.
Logistics: Lift near library annex is slow. Print room: evening noise, repainted, afternoon noise, umbrella. Loading bay: evening noise, coffee machine, free afternoon, repainted, umbrella. East wing: coffee machine, morning stand-up, too cold afternoon/evening, repainted, afternoon noise, slow lift. North office: free morning, repainted, morning noise. Garden studio: coffee machine, afternoon stand-up. Umbrellas in north office, loading bay, east wing, garden studio, print room. Library annex: repainting, afternoon noise.
Preferences: Pia, Kira, Hugo want harbour room clear. Rafe wants print room clear. Ines wants library annex clear. Esme/Finn prefer loading bay. Bram/Leon prefer garden studio. Hugo prefers loading bay. Ada prefers garden studio for reviews.
Actions: Send notes to Una, Wren, Dell (morning); Opal, Mira, Teo (afternoon); Cora, Ada, Pia, Opal (evening). Check Mira before evening meeting. Remind about Finn, Bram, Hugo, Leon, Ada preferences. Leon asked if library annex free afternoon.
New Info: Leon thinks print room too cold morning. Suri thinks garden studio too cold evening.
